title: Help
subtitle: User roles and access permission matrix

SuperAdmin.name: Super Admin
SuperAdmin.description: Full access. Manages all users, assigns roles and configures the system.

Admin.name: Admin
Admin.description: Manages orders and creates moderators. Cannot change roles or manage other admins.

Moderator.name: Moderator
Moderator.description: Works with orders, customers and statuses. The Administrators section is not available.

capabilities.manageModerators: Name, activity and Telegram of moderators
capabilities.manageAllAdmins: Name, activity and Telegram of all users

notes.ownRole: A super admin cannot change their own role.
notes.adminModerators: An admin manages moderators only and cannot change roles.
notes.moderator: A moderator has no access to admin management.
